row.title: Blind-spot register runs on clocks: backup drill, domain expiry, licences, computed sweeps
row.body: BLINDSPOT-1: fresh: probes make backup-restore, domain-renewal and name-clearance go stale by themselves; foundation/backup.py restores each D1 export into scratch SQLite and stores it in R2; foundation/licences.py inventories dependencies; blindspots --tick runs daily inside the product manager pass; item done checks are commands that re-measure. 11 sweeps answered with evidence in ops/blindspots/answers.jsonl.
